Haus of Sutra x Lush Bar is taking over Belltown’s best-kept secret for a stacked queer-led night of glam, giggles, and unhinged excellence.

📅 3/6

Seattle… are you ready for RED LIGHT?

Friday, February 27th we’re taking over Belltown Yacht Club for a late-night underground queer rave experience.

🔴 Dress in your hottest RED look
🎧 DJs spinning house, techno & high-energy beats
🍸 Craft cocktails flowing
🔥 Sexy go-go dancers
⏰ 9PM–2AM

This is your official invite to tap into Seattle’s underground LGBTQ+ nightlife scene in Belltown’s best kept secret.

Pull up. Bring your crew. Stay until the lights come up.
